subject: sentences
title: One or more than one
about: He counts the pictures and taps the word that matches: one cat, three cats, two boxes. CKLA Unit 5 teaches plurals with -s and -es, and NC expects regular plural nouns by the end of first grade.
tip: Say the rule with him: one thing gets no s; more than one gets s, or es after s, x, ch or sh.
